reviews.title: Great bang for your buck
reviews.comment: If you are looking at these XT processors, it’s easy to get confused on X vs XT. The XT processors are X, but with a slight boost and a cpu cooling fan. The X does not come with a fan. This is important because $20-50 for a CPU cooler and $10 thermal paste is not adding to your budget. Everything you need is there. You’ll likely not see much performance increase over the X with the XT, but it’s the bundle is where your focus is at.
reviews.author: D.Graham

reviews.title: Quite a little monster
reviews.comment: This little 6 core monster most definitely hits 4.7ghz. With PBO I have all mine at 4.90 to 4.95 ghz as a 6 core. It must be a 5800x with 2 missing cores. Because it sure acts like one. I've now built 3 systems with this cpu in particular. Paired with 3600 cl16 ram it works like a charm. And about to order yet another one.
reviews.author: Patrick Prafke
